name: Mall Product Security Tether
summary: An unbranded two-pad retail display tether for a laptop on a demonstration table.
description: A compact satin-finish tabletop base and a low-profile device sensor are joined by a curved graphite lead with two molded strain reliefs. The raised sensor seats on the original laptop palm rest.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original parameterized Blender mesh sections, rounded adhesive soles and curved jacketed lead.
